messages.subject: SEM Estimates for measurement model
parts:
Dear Lavaan developers,

I've carried out SEM using lavaan package. All inputs to the SEM were standardized (using scale function) prior to entry to sem functions. The regression coefficients are all in 0-1 range, however in some instances the measurement model estimates are above 1. I did not define any residual correlations and the coefficients in my model are either regression or for latent model definition. 

Any help is greatly appreciated?

Cheers,
Arash

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Re: SEM Estimates for measurement model
parts:
This is not necessarily a problem. It's possible to have regression coefficients greater than 1 even in a regression model, but it's a possible sign that you have a collinearity problem, or that you have a misspecified model.

Here's an example:

library(QuantPsyc)
set.seed(123)
x <- rnorm(10)
y <- rnorm(10) + x^2 + x^3
x2 <- x^2
x3 <- x^3
x4 <- x^4
lm.beta(lm(y ~ x + x2 + x3 ))
. 
And here's a short paper that explains how it happens: 
http://www.ssicentral.com/lisrel/techdocs/HowLargeCanaStandardizedCoefficientbe.pdf
